extension.summary: Movies and series for Lucent, with AIOStreams and Trakt
Films en series voor Lucent, met AIOStreams en Trakt
extension.description: Browse with TMDB, play through your own AIOStreams address and keep your progress on Trakt. Works without Seren.
Bladeren met TMDB, afspelen via je eigen AIOStreams-adres en je voortgang bijhouden op Trakt. Werkt zonder Seren.
extension.news: 0.25.0: Type with your phone: scan the QR code on the TV to search and send a film or series to the TV. Bedtime per profile: a time and/or a number of titles per day. 0.24.0: Start at once: sources for what you will most likely watch are looked up beforehand. Ready for tonight. A lighter version when the video keeps buffering. Sound and subtitle remembered per series. Skip intros per series. Message when a new season is announced. Browse by studio, network, decade and award. 0.23.0: Account information for Trakt, Simkl, debrid services, Easynews and MDBList. 0.22.0: What you watch in the Kodi library is marked as watched on Trakt too. 0.21.0: The cast opens as a pop-up with round portraits, with the film still visible behind it; OK shows everything with that actor. 0.20.0: What shall we watch? Tick who watches and what you feel like, and get three titles none of you saw yet. Your year of watching: hours, films, episodes, most watched series and favourite kinds. Previous time: the resume window tells what happened in the episode before. 0.19.0: Ready in top quality: a message when a film on your watchlist or a new episode can be played in the quality you want (off by default). Sources that keep failing on this device move down, ones that play well move up. Watch together: tick who watches along and it is marked as watched for them too. Offer to open your own subscription app (Android). Subtitles in your language checked beforehand with Lucent Subtitles.
